name: Motor
description: An electric motor with two states: Armature current (A) and Angular velocity of the rotor (rad/s), both starting at 0. It has no equations of its own. Armature dynamics, from a Voltage source or a Battery, drives the current, and reads the speed back as the back EMF. Shaft dynamics (against a Torque load) or Rotational drive (swinging a Rotational link) turns current into speed. Traction, Discharge and Resistive heating read the current to move a chassis, drain a battery and heat a housing. It spans the electrical and mechanical domains because it converts one into the other.
